description:

description:
The Spirit Mastery update for Titan Quest 2 is out now. Watch the latest Titan Quest 2 trailer for the action RPG for a deep dive into the new update, as the new Spirit Mastery allows you to wield the powers of the Underworld. Manipulate the forces of life and death to summon spirits of the dead and cast otherworldly spells to haunt the living. Draw from your own life force to sustain their advance and boost their effectiveness. Displace and debuff your opponents by siphoning their life force, or even executing them altogether.

Spirit makes use of Shades, a new resource exclusive to the Mastery. They can be used to fuel any way to play Spirit: As a full-on Summoner, a pure Spellcaster or hybrid playstyles.

The mastery also allows you to sacrifice life instead of energy and, on the flip side, has a big focus on Vitality Damage and life leech to balance this out.

title: Titan Quest 2 - Official Spirit Mastery Update Launch Trailer | THQ Nordic Digital Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get ready for a Hero of MEKA proportions with the arrival of D.Mon! D.Mon takes the spotlight in this Overwatch D.Mon gameplay trailer. Check it out to see this newest Tank Hero in action. D.Mon arrives when Overwatch's Season 4: Heroes of Busan launches on August 11, 2026. 

Former pro gamer Yuna Lee joins the Overwatch roster. Piloting her mech, Beast, D.Mon slices through her enemies up close with her Plasma Saber and defends her team using her Power Barrier.

Activate her Propulsors to quickly maneuver the battlefield, fire up her Fusion Repeater for added pressure on the enemy team, and set your team up for success when you unleash her Ultimate, Limit Break.

Similar to D.Va, you’ll also be able to eject from D.Mon’s mech when you’ve taken too much damage and call it back when you’re ready for the next team fight.
title: Overwatch - Official New Hero: D.Mon Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get another look at Drop Loot in this trailer for the upcoming loot-matching, synergy-chaining, monster-exploding, roguelite dungeon crawler game. Match tiles to deal damage and heal, stack powers to create chain reactions, descend to the heart of the well and paint it all red. Drop Loot will be available on PC. The first public playtest for Drop Loot begins today, August 7 at 9 AM PDT / 6 PM CEST and runs until August 14. 

In the playtest, you enter the game’s first level, the Jungle, and descend through 20 increasingly dangerous depths filled with monsters, loot, upgrades, and opportunities to create powerful chain reactions.

Reaching depth 20 completes the main Jungle challenge, but the descent does not end there. Players can continue into endless mode, where enemies become progressively stronger and each new depth puts their build and strategy under greater pressure.

The playtest features three unique playable characters: Woria, Arja, and Bombi.
title: Drop Loot - Official Steam Playtest Trailer

description: Danchi Days gets a new trailer and a release date. Watch the latest Danchi Days trailer for this upcoming slice-of-life adventure game. In Danchi Days, 12-year old Hoshino Kanaoka moves back to her Japanese hometown to be with her grandma, now living with dementia. Hoping to cheer her up, Hoshino decides to revive the local summer festival by inviting her quirky neighbors. In this comedic-yet-bittersweet tale, uncover forgotten truths about Hoshino's neighborhood, overcome opponents who stand against the festival, and explore the everyday world of her danchi (a Japanese mass housing complex). Danchi Days will be available on October 29, 2026.
